# realtime API

The WebSocket for live state and command results (protocol in the guide).

Base path `/api/v1/realtime` behind the gateway. Authentication, rate limits and the error format are the same for every service: see [Scripting MowDeck](../../guides/scripting.md). Rendered from [`apps/web/openapi/realtime.json`](https://github.com/lukislp/mowdeck/blob/main/apps/web/openapi/realtime.json) (OpenAPI 3.1), which you can also load into any OpenAPI tool.

## Operations

This service has no HTTP operations for clients.

## WebSocket

`GET /api/v1/realtime/ws` upgrades to a WebSocket (not part of the OpenAPI document). The first message authenticates with an access token (`{"type": "auth", "token": "..."}`), then `subscribe` names the mowers. Messages, close codes and limits: [ADR 0018](../../adr/0018-realtime-websocket-protocol.md) and the [realtime README](https://github.com/lukislp/mowdeck/blob/main/services/realtime/README.md); a complete client is in [Scripting MowDeck](../../guides/scripting.md).
